historical_references.reference: Bikramajit Ketan Chowdhury, also known as Bicky, was a prominent freedom fighter from Assam who led the Indian National Congress during the Quit India movement. He was imprisoned by the British for his involvement in the movement.

Bikramaditya, also known as Bicky, was a ruler of the Vijayanagara Empire in the Deccan region of India during the late 15th and early 16th centuries. He is known for his military victories against the Bahamani Sultanate and the Deccan sultanate of Bidar.
